warmup.description: Activate full body with emphasis on power, coordination, and joint readiness for complex lifts.

main_exercises.name: Barbell Clean to Front Squat
main_exercises.load_guidance: Use a challenging load at 7-8/10 effort, prioritizing speed and technique over max weight
main_exercises.form_cue: Explode through hips and catch the bar in a stable front rack position

main_exercises.name: Push Press (Barbell or Dumbbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate-heavy load that allows powerful drive with 1-2 reps in reserve
main_exercises.form_cue: Use legs to initiate the press and finish strong overhead

main_exercises.name: Pendlay Row
main_exercises.load_guidance: Heavy load with strict form, resetting each rep on the floor
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep torso parallel to the floor and pull explosively to the lower chest

main_exercises.name: Deficit Reverse Lunge (Dumbbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Challenging load that allows full depth and balance control
main_exercises.form_cue: Step back into a deep lunge while keeping front foot stable

main_exercises.name: Renegade Row to Push-Up Combo
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load focusing on stability and control throughout
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep hips square and perform push-up with full range

main_exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight with controlled tempo, avoid swinging
main_exercises.form_cue: Engage core and lift legs without using momentum

cooldown.description: Reduce full-body tension and restore mobility after explosive and heavy work.
movements: Lat stretch hanging or on wall x 30s each side

phase_notes.menstrual: This session’s complexity and intensity may feel high—scale back load and focus on technique, especially in explosive lifts like cleans. Take longer rest as needed.
phase_notes.follicular: Great phase to develop power and coordination—push intensity in Olympic-style lifts and focus on explosive execution. You may feel more athletic and responsive.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Peak performance phase—maximize power output and push heavier loads while maintaining precise technique. This is ideal for complex, full-body movements.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain strong effort but avoid overreaching—focus on clean, controlled reps and consistent performance across sets, especially in technical lifts.
phase_notes.late_luteal: This session may feel especially demanding—reduce complexity (e.g., simplify clean variations) or lower load. Prioritize control and avoid pushing intensity.
